name: Mito Mashiro
source:
"Since you are going to be my son-in-law, please be a mature man!"

She has the strongest power as a Tayutai — as a transformation of Kikuramikami no Hime.
Her dream is to achieve the "Coexistence between Humans and Tayutais" and after what happened in Ashihara-cho, she started to travel nationwide with her husband, [url=/c41669]Mito Yuuri[/url].

She finds out that Takachiho City is filled with Shinki, which is quite rare. Therefore she established Yachimata Shrine and starts to live there together with [url=/c41665]Mito Kohaku[/url] ever since then.
She is usually a mature woman with good manners, but she also has her stubborn side and never changes her mind.

[Edited from [url=http://hikarifield.com/tayutama2_en/character/character004.html]English Website[/url]]
